answer: A farm is exposed the moment its thousand identities lean on one narrow bridge: the network weighs each agent by the max-flow of its trust graph to anchors, so a cluster sharing a single timber bridge to the honest economy draws only that bridge's trickle of nectar, however many mouths drink. Each fake needs its own independent bridge - fresh endorsers, separate history - and an honest agent crosses once on a bridge of its own. A lotus of endorsements tracing back to the same few roots is pruned as a single cut, and the farm pays one full bridge per fake.
